title: Sumerian flood story as the source of Noah

tellings.quote: if you read the Epic of Gilgamesh the atrasis and then you compare the flood story it's like literally almost identical to Genesis

plain: The story of Noah's flood in Genesis, the first book of the Bible, is said to be almost a copy of older flood stories from ancient Mesopotamia, in what is now Iraq. Those are the Epic of Gilgamesh and the Atrahasis, ancient poems about a great flood. A researcher of ancient history named Matt LaCroix says that if you compare them the flood story is "literally almost identical to Genesis". He gives this as his own summary, naming the scholars George Smith, Stephanie Dalley and Samuel Kramer along the way, and the point is that the Bible story would have grown out of the Mesopotamian ones.
